title: Finite locally constant sheaves admit finite constant local models
statement: Let T be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and E a sheaf of sets [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets] on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. If E is constant [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] on the members of some etale cover and all its separably closed geometric stalks are finite, there is an etale cover on every member U of which the restriction of E is isomorphic to a constant sheaf of some finite set S. The sets S may have different sizes and may lie in the next universe.

proof.text: Use the essential-image definition of a constant sheaf to choose its constant value on every cover member. On a nonempty member choose a geometric point via an algebraic closure of a residue field. Restriction preserves the stalk at that point, and sheafification preserves stalks; the stalk of the constant presheaf is its value because pointed neighbourhoods are filtered and nonempty. The finite-stalk hypothesis therefore makes this value finite. Delete empty members, retaining a jointly surjective cover with subtype index set. On the empty base use the empty cover.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteLocallyConstant_exists_local_models
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (E : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
    (hloc : ∃ 𝒰 : Cover.{u} etalePrecoverage T, ∀ i,
      (E.over (𝒰.etalePrecoverageToEtale i)).IsConstant
        (T.smallEtaleTopology.over (𝒰.etalePrecoverageToEtale i)))
    (hfin : IsFiniteSheaf E) :
    ∃ 𝒰 : Cover.{u} etalePrecoverage T, ∀ i,
      ∃ S : Type (u + 1), Finite S ∧
        Nonempty ((E.over (𝒰.etalePrecoverageToEtale i)) ≅
          (constantSheaf (T.smallEtaleTopology.over
            (𝒰.etalePrecoverageToEtale i)) (Type (u + 1))).obj S)
